subject.title: Dashboard: shared vs private tabs + role/scope-gated visibility

question: Should modular dashboard private/shared tabs be a soft UI filter inside one trusted Gateway operator domain, or a hard authorization boundary that prevents other operator devices from reading stored tab data?
rationale: Current docs state operator scopes are not multi-tenant isolation, while this issue asks to prevent teammate or contractor leakage; automation cannot choose that security contract safely.

options.title: Design hard authz first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer security/product design for tab ownership, read/write scopes, migration, and docs before implementation is queued.

options.title: Limit to soft filtering
options.body: Implement convenience filtering and provenance only in the dashboard plugin, and document that separate Gateways remain required for real privacy boundaries.

options.title: Defer until dashboard lands
options.body: Pause this subtask until the Wave 1 dashboard PRs merge or are rejected, then re-triage against the accepted schema.

recommendation.title: Design hard authz first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer security/product design for tab ownership, read/write scopes, migration, and docs before implementation is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current Control UI plugin-tab seam and operator-scope boundary docs, so he is the best routed owner for the security-contract choice.
